T_SAFECAST_OPEN_DATA_WARNING: Safecast is an open data platform. Uploaded measurements, timestamps, and location data may become public open data.
T_SAFECAST_PROFILE_NOTE: Copy your API key from your Safecast profile. Leave the field empty here to keep the stored key.
T_TEXT_DOWNLOAD_BACKUP: Grab a JSON snapshot of the current configuration for safekeeping.
T_TEXT_RESTORE_BACKUP: Select a previously exported JSON file. The device will apply the settings immediately.
T_MSG_CHOOSE_FILE: Please choose a backup file first.
T_LOG_CONSOLE_HINT: Live serial debug output refreshed every few seconds.
T_REMOTE_OTA_DESC: The bridge can download the latest signed build directly from the RadPro WiFi Bridge repository.
T_REMOTE_STATUS_SUCCESS: Update complete. The bridge will reboot shortly.
T_MANUAL_OTA_DESC: Upload a ZIP file that contains manifest.json and every .bin listed inside. The bridge will flash each part in order.
T_MANUAL_NO_FILE: Please choose a firmware ZIP first.
T_MANUAL_BAD_ZIP: ZIP file is missing manifest.json or one of the binary parts.
T_MANUAL_BUSY: An OTA operation is already in progress.
T_MANUAL_DONE: Upload complete! The bridge will restart to apply the update.
T_RADPRO_SCOPE: Update the connected detector to Rad Pro 3.1.1. Requires stable Rad Pro 3.0.2 or later (3.x) on Bosean FS-600, FS-1000, FS-5000 or GQ GMC-800.
T_RADPRO_SELECT: Download the file above, then select it here. The bridge checks its model, size and SHA-256 before entering the bootloader.
T_RADPRO_POWER: Keep the detector and bridge powered and connected throughout the update. Measurements pause during flashing. An interrupted flash may need recovery with the upstream installer. Settings and log pages are not deliberately erased; back up important data first.
T_RADPRO_CONFIRM: I accept the Rad Pro terms and want to install 3.1.1 on this detector.
T_RADPRO_UNSUPPORTED: FNIRSI GC-01, JOY-IT JT-RAD01 and GC-03 use vendor USB drive bootloaders; the upstream guides require Windows. FS2011 and YT-203B need an external programmer. These methods are not implemented by this bridge.
T_RADPRO_SUPPORTED: This model supports updates through the bridge. Hardware validation is pending.
T_RADPRO_NOT_SUPPORTED: This detector/firmware combination cannot be updated through the bridge. See the installation guides below.
T_RADPRO_WRONG_FILE: Select the exact firmware file linked for the chosen model and language.
T_RADPRO_PHASE_STAGED: Firmware staged. Select the file again to install, or discard it.
T_RADPRO_PHASE_CONNECTING: Checking detector identity and starting bootloader…
T_RADPRO_PHASE_ERASING: Erasing application pages. Keep power connected.
T_RADPRO_PHASE_WRITING: Writing and verifying firmware. Keep power connected.
T_RADPRO_PHASE_COMPLETE: Rad Pro 3.1.1 verified. Telemetry is resuming.
T_RADPRO_PHASE_FAILED: Update stopped. Read the error below; keep power connected. Retry the staged firmware if offered, or use the official installer.
